item.title: Amid Trump election threats, Colorado House passes bill that would extend mail voting, drop-off periods
item.description: “Coloradans deserve to cast their ballot without barriers, and this bill safeguards against federal interference in our elections and makes it easier to vote," said Rep. Emily Sirota of Denver.

item.title: Trial against Meta in New Mexico highlights video depositions by top executives
item.description: The case could help set the course for thousands of lawsuits against social media companies.

item.title: A trial seeks to tie Iranian paramilitary to alleged assassination plot in US
item.description: The allegations emerged in Asif Merchant's attempted terrorism trial on Tuesday.

item.title: Questions mount in Congress over Iran war’s costs, risks and exit plan
item.description: Lawmakers are demanding answers over what is quickly becoming a widening Middle East conflict.

item.title: Trump says ‘someone from within’ Iranian regime might be best choice to lead once war ends
item.description: Trump has not publicly identified anyone he views as a credible future leader for Iran.

item.title: Alexander brothers used wealth to lure, drug and rape women and girls, prosecutor says
item.description: The brothers have pleaded not guilty to sex trafficking and other charges.

item.title: A large immigration detention camp in Texas is closed to visitors amid measles outbreak
item.description: There are 14 active measles cases and 112 people are being isolated at the facility.

item.title: US soldiers who died in Iran war remembered as devoted parents and reservists
item.description: All were assigned to the 103rd Sustainment Command.

item.title: Fearing GOP upset, top California Democrat urges lagging candidates for governor to drop out of race
item.description: The all-GOP general election is possible under California's unusual top-two primary system.

item.title: Colorado House committee shoots down bill targeting high stadium prices on beer, hot dogs
item.description: "I wish, for me, I didn't find so many booby traps every time I started to look at (the consequences) if we do this," Rep. Chad Clifford said.
